old_title: Colombia rescue efforts press on after deadly earthquake

old_text:
Colombia rescue efforts press on after deadly earthquake
Issued on:
Share
Rescue efforts across western Colombia carried into a second day on Tuesday as emergency workers dug through collapsed buildings and flattened homes, amid expectations that the death toll from the country's most powerful earthquake in decades could rise. FRANCE 24's Camille Corcoran brings us more with this report.
